fact: The 2020/2021 school census was filled in on printed questionnaires with enumerators' help, checked in the field, then entered into the CAPI application on tablets by provincial staff, collected August to September 2021.
title: Annuaire Statistique 2020/2021 du Secteur de l'Éducation et de la Formation
publisher: Direction Générale des Statistiques, de la Planification et de la Prospective, Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale
